snippet.title: Tidal Rush (Tech Demo) – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Join us on https://discord.gg/EwxMmqDfap, share your feedback and play the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3365750/Tidal_Rush_Tech_Demo/

Jump on your Hydrospeeder and hit the waves in our very first, very early Tidal Rush Tech Demo – a high-speed arcade racer where fun always comes first! Master water physics and engage in friendly competition in both singleplayer and multiplayer races!
